events.region: Cleveland, OK; Grady, OK; McClain, OK; Oklahoma, OK
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Cleveland County in central Oklahoma...
Northeastern Grady County in central Oklahoma...
Northwestern McClain County in central Oklahoma...
Eastern Oklahoma County in central Oklahoma...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 644 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.

Midwest City, Newcastle, Blanchard, Choctaw, Noble, Tuttle,
Harrah, Jones, Nicoma Park, Goldsby, Luther, Amber, Bridge Creek,
Stanley Draper Lake, northwestern Lake Thunderbird and Stella.

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Eastern Canadian County in central Oklahoma...
Northwestern Cleveland County in central Oklahoma...
Southeastern Kingfisher County in central Oklahoma...
Southwestern Logan County in central Oklahoma...
Oklahoma County in central Oklahoma...

* Until 930 AM CDT.

heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

City, El Reno, Guthrie, Newcastle, Yukon, Bethany, Mustang,
Choctaw, Warr Acres, The Village, Tuttle, Piedmont, Spencer,
Nichols Hills and Jones.

events.region: Blaine, OK; Caddo, OK; Canadian, OK; Grady, OK
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The National Weather Service in Norman has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Oklahoma...

Canadian River near Bridgeport affecting Blaine, Canadian, Grady
and Caddo Counties.

For the Upper Canadian River...including Taloga, Bridgeport, Mustang,
Norman, Purcell, Calvin...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Canadian River near Bridgeport.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* IMPACTS...At 14.0 feet, Flooding affects croplands... pastures...
and oil wells near the river. Low-lying bottomlands near the river
may be cut off from easy access by high water in side channels.
Sand dredging operations are affected. Upstream points in southern
Blaine County experience flooding before the areas near Bridgeport
in northern Caddo County. Downstream points in southwestern
Canadian County are affected hours later.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:45 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 13.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 14.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
morning to a crest of 14.5 feet this afternoon. It will then fall
below flood stage late this afternoon.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 14.5
feet on 03/17/1998.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
